name: Sunil Healthcare Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1976, Sunil Healthcare Ltd is a manufacturer of Empty Hard Gelatin, HPMC Capsule Shells & Ayurvedic Medicines[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is the second-largest manufacturer of Empty Hard Shell Gelatin Capsules in India which its sells under the brand name Sunloc. Company does production of double lock, triple lock, multiple groove capsules of EHGC & some proportion of vegan HPMC (Hydroxy Propyl Methyl Cellulose) along with liner, circular, two color printing & 360degree printing being offered

pros: Stock is trading at 1.04 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 3.56% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.01% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 182 days.
